assumptions.students: 50 synthetic students: 15 year-1, 15 year-2, 12 year-3, 8 year-4; 16-week semester
assumptions.mastery: can teach a course with prob 0.15 (y1), 0.35 (y2), 0.55 (y3), 0.65 (y4); 'low supply' halves these
assumptions.need: weekly prob of needing help 0.55 (y1), 0.45 (y2), 0.25 (y3), 0.15 (y4); course drawn uniformly
assumptions.avoidance: 23% are help-avoidant (Karabenick 2003) and request with half the base prob
assumptions.availability: each student is free in 3-6 of 10 weekly slots
assumptions.tutor_willingness: each of up to 3 suggested tutors (8 in 'fall-through') accepts with prob 0.6 (0.3 in 'low supply'); max 2 h teaching per week
assumptions.session: 1 h per session; +1 tutor, -1 learner; balance never below zero
assumptions.recruited_seniors: scenario C adds 10 senior tutors who teach 80% of courses and never request
assumptions.safety_net: a student at zero gets +1 credit at the start of a week, at most N grants per semester

results.scenario: D. B + safety net, max 4 per semester
E. B + safety net, max 6 per semester (adopted)
F. E with low tutor supply (sensitivity)
H. G + fall-through to up to 8 tutors (adopted)
